scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
{0} Prisoner #{1}{2},
what's the noise over there?
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
{0} 囚犯#{1}{2}，
那边在吵什么？

scripts.text: Let me free, I'll pay!
scripts.translation: 放我出去，我付钱！

scripts.text: Let me to work off my freedom!
scripts.translation: 让我干活换取自由！

scripts.text: Nothing
scripts.translation: 没什么

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
I can't remember you. Is it your 1st time?
You again? Somebody hasn't grown wiser from the very first visit...
OK, we could release you for ^FF0000{0}z^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
我不记得你。第一次来？
又是你？看来第一次进来时还没学乖...
好吧，交^FF0000{0}z^000000，我们就放你出去。

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
You again? Somebody hasn't grown wiser from the very first visit...
OK, we could release you for ^FF0000{0}z^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
又是你？看来第一次进来时还没学乖...
好吧，交^FF0000{0}z^000000，我们就放你出去。

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
I can't remember you. Is it your 1st time?
OK, we could release you for ^FF0000{0}z^000000.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
OK, we could release you for ^FF0000{0}z^000000.
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
好吧，交^FF0000{0}z^000000，我们就放你出去。

scripts.text: I pay cash!
scripts.translation: 我付现金！

scripts.text: Do you accept cheques?
scripts.translation: 你们收支票吗？

scripts.text: I've changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 我改变主意了

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
You've got some time to think about...
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
你还有时间考虑一下...

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
OK, sing here and there.
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
好，在这里和那里签字。

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
What's this? It's not enough!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
就这么点？钱不够！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
OK, sign your cheque. And put down your name in my book.
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
好吧，签一下支票。然后在我的账本上写下你的名字。

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Your case says nothing about your bank accounts.
Alas, there's your bank account info... ^FF0000{0}z^000000... in the case. It's not enough.
Stop your silly games now!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
你的档案里没有银行账户的记录。
唉，档案里记着你的账户余额...^FF0000{0}z^000000...这点钱不够。
别再耍这些无聊的把戏了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Alas, there's your bank account info... ^FF0000{0}z^000000... in the case. It's not enough.
Stop your silly games now!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
唉，档案里记着你的账户余额...^FF0000{0}z^000000...这点钱不够。
别再耍这些无聊的把戏了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Your case says nothing about your bank accounts.
Stop your silly games now!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
你的案卷里没有关于你银行账户的信息。
别再玩这种无聊的把戏了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Stop your silly games now!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
别再玩这种无聊的把戏了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
You are free now!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
你现在自由了！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Our stocks are short of toadstools.  Remember your morning's skilly?  What about some work at our sponsored mushroom farm?
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
我们的毒蘑菇库存不够了。还记得你早上喝的稀粥吗？要不要去我们资助的蘑菇农场干点活？

scripts.text: OK, I'll work off!
scripts.translation: 好的，我去干活！

scripts.text: I love this prison!
scripts.translation: 我爱这座监狱！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
I'm sorry, you should release your Cart, PecoPeco or Falcon!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
抱歉，先卸下手推车，放走大嘴鸟或猎鹰吧！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Talk to our overseer, Oliver.
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
去找我们的监工奥利弗谈谈。

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Is today X-Mas time, huh?
Now shut up and back off!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
今天是圣诞节吗？
现在闭嘴，退后！

scripts.text:
[Saddeus]
Now shut up and back off!
scripts.translation:
[萨德乌斯]
现在闭嘴，退后！

scripts.text: [Oliver]
scripts.translation: [奥利弗]

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
I want you to gather ^FF0000{0} Orange Net Mushroom^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
我要你采集^FF0000{0}个毒香菇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
I want you to gather ^FF0000{0} Orange Net Mushroom^000000.
OK... hand me all the shrooms...
Let me see... {1} of almost edible ones...
And {2} useless deadly ones.
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
我要你采集^FF0000{0}个毒香菇^000000。
好...把蘑菇都交给我...
让我看看...{1}个勉强能吃的...
还有{2}个没用的剧毒蘑菇。

scripts.text:
[Oliver]
Thank you. You are free!
scripts.translation:
[奥利弗]
谢谢。你自由了！

scripts.text:
Hmm... You've been here already... Well-well...
Drop these mushrooms!! They are poisonous!
OK, you must bring me ^FF0000{0}^000000 edible ^FF0000Orange Net Mushroom^000000 toadstoo.. shrooms.
You're a fast fella! You'll have to get more shrooms, then.
And you may eat the deadly ones for breakfast.
scripts.translation:
嗯...你以前来过这里...好，好...
把这些蘑菇扔掉！它们有毒！
好的，你必须给我带来^FF0000{0}^000000个能吃的^FF0000毒香菇^000000，毒蘑...蘑菇。
你动作真快！看来你得再采一些蘑菇了。
至于那些致命的，你可以留着当早餐吃。
